comment: Enemy archetypes. Body dimensions are in tiles and scale a named outline from shapes.json. Weapon values are the approved v3 tuning; provenance docs/mechanics.md.

crystal-worm-child-head.comment: spawnTiles is the approved north spawn, a 3-tile center-to-wall margin inside the 19.2-tile arena.

killer-bee-queen.comment: Step 23.2's harmless eight-phase skeleton (K16): real body, health, thresholds, telegraphs, invulnerability and movement from docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md, with zero attacks and zero minions - those are steps 23.3-23.10. Fidelity gaps, all trainer-authored pending a later step's own sourcing: every telegraphSeconds/invulnerableOnEnterSeconds except phase 6's sourced 29s; every sub-phase durationSeconds; every movement speed/radius/rate not stated by the source as a number. Phase 6's exitAfterSeconds and invulnerableOnEnterSeconds are both the source's sourced 29 seconds (K08), which is why phase 7 repeats phase 6's 25% threshold instead of draining through it.

body.comment: Hitbox Size 2 (docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md stats table), mapped to 2x2 tiles - this project's interpretation of the wiki's unitless hitbox size, not a published tile equivalence.

health.comment: maxHealthHp 112,500 is the source's Base HP. progression.hpPerSecond 375 is K15 (approved simulated raid DPS), not a published value.

phases.comment: Source (23.3): radial blue-bomb ring (Quiet), targeted white-bomb (Dazed), and three stacked stinger spreads (red/blue/yellow, 3 shots each = 9 shards) sharing one cadence. Authored on the phase itself so both sub-phases (circling the room vs the pond) fire identically. Bomb travelSeconds and every cadence/arc value are trainer-authored; the five projectiles and their shapes are wiki-prose.
Source: at 90% HP the room floods and she alternates chasing while red/blue/yellow; invulnerable between colours. Three colour sub-phases, no attacks yet.

subPhases.comment: Source (23.4): multi-directional spread of Small Red Stingers, single directed Large Red Stinger, and a non-aimed radial ring of Red Bombs (Confused) so standing in front of the Queen misses them. Spawns despawn-on-exit Red Killer Bees. Invulnerable between colours (K08 pauses the drain).

Source (23.4): directed spread of Large Blue Stingers, a rotating spiral of Small Blue Stingers, a 360-degree scatter spray of Blue Balls, and a non-aimed radial ring of Blue Bombs (Quiet). Spawns despawn-on-exit Blue Killer Bees.

Source (23.4): 3-way spread of Large Yellow Stingers, a rotating spiral of Yellow Balls, and a non-aimed radial ring of White Bombs (Dazed) with a large arm count for 'a large number'. Spawns despawn-on-exit Yellow Killer Bees.

phases.comment: Source (23.5): at 75% HP she despawns phase 2's minions (automatic via their despawnOnExit) and moves to the arena centre, flashing white, then stays stationary (move-to-point stops on arrival; no second mechanism) while firing a six-attack barrage: two counter-rotating 3-arm blue spirals, one clockwise 2-arm red spiral, frequent non-rotating yellow rings, occasional 4-way bee bursts, an 8-arm white-bomb ring on the compass bearings, and a red-glaive wave Armor-Breaking for 7s that fires at entry and every 7 seconds (the only cadence the source states; every other cadence here is trainer-authored). Fidelity gap: the source calls the glaive wave 'unavoidable', true only in the real fight's small room - this project's 19.2-tile arena makes it dodgeable near the wall, recorded rather than faked by widening the wave (deferred to 24.2).

Source (23.6): at 60% HP she slowly circles counter-clockwise in the centre while firing 4-directional glaive spreads, each colour's ring sharing one cadence but advancing its own, mutually-prime bearing per burst (7/11/13 degrees - none share a divisor with 90, so the four-arm rings never realign; asserted over many bursts rather than trusted) so standing still cannot dodge them. Also fires the Tips-sourced 'shotgun of Red Hive Shots' (200 unblockable/armour-piercing damage each, 600 total tanked) as a three-shot player-aimed spread of hive-spiral-shot-v1: the behaviour prose for this phase never mentions it, but the Tips text is specific, quantitative and names phase 4, and row 15's 200-damage armour-piercing projectile matches the quoted 600 exactly, so the conflict is resolved by including it (recorded here rather than silently dropped). Fidelity gap: the Plagued Nest's faster spinner spreads and multicoloured 4-way spiral are excluded (K07).

Source (23.7): at 45% HP the entrance hardens and colour attacks return, denser than phases 2-4. Each sub-phase reuses its colour's Killer Bee from 23.4. Readings: 'streams'/'messy bombardment ... in all directions' are scatter (red narrow-cone, blue full 360, akin to a Djinn's pattern); 'radial bursts' are non-rotating rings; '3-directional'/'wide, directed' shotguns are player-aimed spreads (red's phrasing matches 23.6's own Tips-sourced hive-spiral shotgun reading); '4-directional' of a radial attack (blue's Small Blue Stingers, yellow's Hive Shots) is a 4-arm ring, matching 23.6's reading of 'spreads' of glaives; 'short spiralling bursts' is a small-arm ring with a rotation rate. Fidelity gaps: the hardening entrance tiles acting as walls and the disconnect-on-colour-change mechanic are not modelled (K05, D01); the Queen's Stun vulnerability on colour switch has no effect (D05); the Plagued Nest's green sub-phase is excluded (K07).

Source: at 25% HP she returns to the centre, flashing red, invulnerable for the sourced 29 seconds while 3 Nests spawn (K08: no health cost, so phase 7 re-enters at the same 25%). Step 23.8: the 2-arm gapped, spreading machinegun of red-stinger-small and the three Nests, one per colour, despawnOnExit false so they survive into phase 7.

Source: swells in size and reverts to colour attacks with Beehemoth escorts - yellow stays central, red circles slowly, blue chases. Progression override 195 HP/s = encounter's 375 HP/s minus 180 HP/s (3 Beehemoths healing 600 HP each every 10s at the <5-player rate, killer-bee-queen-source.md phase 7 Quantitative Facts row); the Beehemoths' own 7,500 HP self-heal has no referent since they are not damageable, and is omitted (D06 covers the group-size healing tiers). Armored windows are not modelled: Armored only changes how fast a real group kills her, and the authored progression rate already abstracts group DPS entirely.

Source: at 12.5% HP she returns to the centre and fires slow radial bursts of Large Red Stingers, Small Yellow Stingers, Blue Balls, Hive Range Shots and all three Glaives until death. No sub-phases; runs until death since there is no further phase. No progression override here (unlike phase 7's 195 HP/s) - implements the source's 'they will cease healing the boss if her HP decreases further' by using the encounter's full 375 HP/s drain. The three Beehemoths are re-spawned at startPhaseIndex 1 (final-phase behaviour authored in 23.9) with despawnOnExit false, since this phase ends only at death; the source's 'orbit her closely' reuses phase 7's placements.

red-killer-bee.comment: docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md Minion Source Extracts - Red Killer Bee. Chases and fires a single directed shot; 400 HP/25 DEF has no drain (K16's minions are not timed-progression enemies). Spawned by phase 2's red sub-phase, despawn-on-exit.

blue-killer-bee.comment: docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md Minion Source Extracts - Blue Killer Bee. Chases and fires a single directed shot; 400 HP/25 DEF, no drain. Spawned by phase 2's blue sub-phase, despawn-on-exit.

yellow-killer-bee.comment: docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md Minion Source Extracts - Yellow Killer Bee. Chases and fires a single directed shot; 400 HP/25 DEF, no drain. Spawned by phase 2's yellow sub-phase, despawn-on-exit.

small-worker-bee.comment: docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md Minion Source Extracts - Small Worker Bee. 125 HP/25 DEF has no drain. Its slow is contact damage per K17/step 21.5, not a projectile: the source's only attack is an [Invisible] speed-0/range-0 touch. Spawned by an alive Killer Bee Nest's phase.

killer-bee-nest-red.comment: docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md Minion Source Extracts - Killer Bee Nest (Queen), red row. K06: not destructible here, so no health block - the phase always runs its full 29 seconds and always yields the default Beehemoth set (D03 defers Nest destruction and colour control). K18: two-phase archetype - alive fires radial Hive Spiral Shot and spawns Small Worker Bees (once, on entry, not periodically - a fidelity gap this step records), then breaks open into a corpse that fires Red Balls constantly until the encounter ends.

killer-bee-nest-blue.comment: docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md Minion Source Extracts - Killer Bee Nest (Queen), blue row. Same K06/K18 notes as killer-bee-nest-red.

killer-bee-nest-yellow.comment: docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md Minion Source Extracts - Killer Bee Nest (Queen), yellow row. Same K06/K18 notes as killer-bee-nest-red.

adolescent-red-beehemoth.comment: docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md Minion Source Extracts - Adolescent Red Beehemoth. 20,000 HP/40 DEF has no drain (not damageable: the player has no attacks, K01); spawned by phase 7 at startPhaseIndex 0 (aimed pairs/spreads), re-spawned by phase 8 at startPhaseIndex 1 (radial bursts and orb spreads) per K18 - despawn-and-respawn at the phase boundary is an approved simplification of 'they persist', chosen over cross-enemy phase coupling; behaviourally equivalent apart from a visible blink. Movement is a static per-colour approximation of 'orbit her closely' (step's own instruction to avoid minion movement scripting): orbit at a small radius around the arena centre, where the Queen herself stays during phases 7-8.

adolescent-blue-beehemoth.comment: docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md Minion Source Extracts - Adolescent Blue Beehemoth. 20,000 HP/40 DEF has no drain. Movement is a static approximation of 'follows her loosely' (step's own instruction): a slow chase, below the Paladin's speed. Same spawn/re-spawn simplification as the red Beehemoth (K18).

adolescent-yellow-beehemoth.comment: docs/killer-bee-queen-source.md Minion Source Extracts - Adolescent Yellow Beehemoth. 20,000 HP/40 DEF has no drain. Movement is a static approximation of 'circle along the edges of the room' (step's own instruction): orbit at a large radius, near the arena wall. Same spawn/re-spawn simplification as the red Beehemoth (K18).
